rules: Only items with a projected positive maximum_owned_quantity participate.
Active corpse-held items and nested contents reserve quantity for the corpse reservation owner.
New corpse records persist the dead character as reservation owner unless a later proven subsystem supplies another scope.
Legacy corpse records without the new field fall back to CharacterId for save compatibility.
Loot excludes the transferred source quantity from its prior reservation before enforcing the destination owner limit.
Recursive corpse cleanup releases all reservations atomically.
No account, party, guild, world, event, or merchant scope is inferred.

ownership.items: reservation counting, validation, transfer exclusion, and release
ownership.world_runtime: corpse decay scheduling and crash recovery
ownership.librarium: evidence, confidence, and native dependency tracking
